generate: npm pack hackmyagent@<version> --pack-destination <dir> && tar xzf <dir>/hackmyagent-<version>.tgz -C <dir>, then for each name in files: env -i PATH="$PATH" node vendor/hackmyagent/generate.mjs <dir>/package <name> > vendor/hackmyagent/<name>; then set version, integrity (the registry's dist.integrity) and read here and run python3 scripts/build_technique_crosswalk.py
